description: This file defines the MediaEffectsFragment class, a Fragment for applying various image effects to a photo in an Android application. It manages OpenGL rendering, texture loading, effect selection, and application using the Android media.effect API.

classes.name: MediaEffectsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that provides an OpenGL ES 2.0 based UI for applying multiple media effects to an image, leveraging the Android media.effect API and handling effect selection, texture loading, and rendering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the Fragment, sets menu options.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the Fragment from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the GLSurfaceView, restores previous effect state.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu for selecting effects.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles effect selection from menu, triggers re-render.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Per-frame logic: initializes effect context and textures on first run, applies selected effect, renders textures.

methods.name: setCurrentEffect
methods.description: Sets the currently selected effect ID.

methods.name: loadTextures
methods.description: Generates OpenGL textures from resource images.

methods.name: initEffect
methods.description: Initializes the effect object based on selected effect ID, setting parameters appropriately.

methods.name: applyEffect
methods.description: Applies the current effect to the input texture.

methods.name: renderResult
methods.description: Renders the final texture to screen depending on whether an effect is active.
